title: Urea cycle
compartment: Liver; OTC in the mitochondrial matrix; ASS1, ASL and ARG1 in the cytosol

steps.note: Matrix; carbamoyl phosphate comes from CPS1, activated by N-acetylglutamate
Cytosol; citrulline leaves the matrix via ORNT1; ATP yields AMP and diphosphate
Releases fumarate, which links the cycle to the citric acid cycle
Releases urea; ornithine re-enters the matrix via ORNT1 (SLC25A15)
